name: Campingplatz NATURAMA Glockenalm
beschreibung: The NATURAMA Glockenalm campsite is located in the municipality of Fischbachau in the Tiroler part of Austria. The surroundings are characterized by a mountainous forest landscape that serves as a starting point for hiking and mountain bike tours. The campsite's amenities include modern sanitary facilities, electrical hookups, and a small shop. Due to its secluded location, the campsite has a quiet and close-to-nature atmosphere. These qualities make the facility a suitable accommodation for nature lovers, families, and couples seeking relaxation. Spacious pitches with ample privacy round off the offering.
